title: Database Seeding for Testing

structured_notes.concern: The application lacked test data during evaluation, and the STUDENT was wasting significant time doing manual data entry after every database reset.
structured_notes.action_taken: The TEACHER recommended automating the data population process with a database seeding script.
structured_notes.outcome: The STUDENT will create a JSON file of dummy data and a script to automatically populate the PostgreSQL database.
structured_notes.remarks: Automation improves development speed and testing quality. The STUDENT understood the value of seeding.

reference_transcript:
Teacher: Alex, when I tested your system yesterday, there was no data to look at. Testing an empty system is difficult because I cannot see how the tables and charts behave.
Student: I am sorry, Sir. I usually type in test data manually through the frontend every time I rebuild the database, but it takes too long to do it every day.
Teacher: You should not do that manually. It wastes your development time. You need to write a database seeding script.
Student: What does a seeding script do?
Teacher: It is a separate script that automatically inserts dummy data into your PostgreSQL tables when you run it from the terminal. It creates a populated state instantly.
Student: Can I just use a JSON file with sample data and loop through it in Node.js to insert the records?
Teacher: Yes, that is a perfect approach. Create a JSON file with 20 sample users and a few dozen transactions. Write a small script to read that file and run the `INSERT` commands.
Student: That will make testing much faster. I will build the seed script today and include it in the project folder.
Teacher: Make sure you also add a command to run the seed script easily.
reference_summary: The TEACHER noted the difficulty of evaluating an empty system. The STUDENT admitted to wasting time manually entering test data. They agreed that the STUDENT will write a database seeding script to automatically inject dummy data, improving the testing process.
